balls.text: that's Kings XI's highest score in this edition, Munaf errs by bowling a friendly length delivery and Miller clubs that over deep midwicket, another flat six
Miller justifying his elevation, flat six this time, full toss and he makes room and clubs it over long-on
slower one and he made room and mistimed it to the on side
very lucky to get away with that wide delivery, down the leg side and Hussey followed it and failed to put it away, should have been called
slower ball and pulled towards deep midwicket and Miller had to dive at the crease, a direct hit would have sent him back
low full toss wide outside off and jammed to cover
take cover at long-off! Hussey makes room and slams a full delivery over the bowler's head, goes several rows back
fullish delivery and knocked back to the bowler, good comeback by McKay
great improvisation! He was expecting the fuller delivery so he stayed at the crease, opened the face of the bat at the last second and deliberately steered it past the keeper
slower ball and he fetches that from the off stump and pulls hard to deep midwicket
full and wide outside off and he makes a lot of room and jams it to the off side
good yorker, he can only jam it out towards his boot
no full toss this time, slower length delivery steered to the off side
Guess what? Another full toss, only this time it didn't cost a boundary, mistimed towards deep midwicket
for some reason Munaf's dishing out only full tosses, Hussey makes room and lofts him to the sight screen with little effort, brings up his fifty too
another low full toss and he tries to repeat the stroke but this time it bounces towards long-on
lovely shot! Low full toss and he had made room to swipe that over wide long-on, got good distance
tries to fetch a yorker from outside off but could only squeeze it back to the bowler
the fourth ball was the build-up to this one, full and wide and he makes room to bash that alon the turf wide of sweeper cover, had to use a lot of power behind that shot
on the pads and Miller whips it down to deep midwicket
full and he makes room and crashes that down to sweeper cover, came off the middle of the bat
slower ball and he controls the pull down to deep square leg
slower ball and the batsman makes room and chips down the track and chops it to the off side
fullish on the off stump and mistimed down to long-on, turned the face of the bat a little
on the pads and whipped to deep midwicket, 16 off that over
full and hammered down to long-on
good improvisation, another short one and Hussey was down the track and he adjusted by upper cutting it over the vacant slips region
the boundary ball he was looking for, too short on this slow pitch and he clubs it over deep midwicket, plenty of takers in the crowd to catch that
makes room and Pollard follows him by bowling it on the body, clips it away past square leg for a easy couple
quietly knocks it down to square leg for a single, Punjab need a few big overs now
another short one and he pulls but the ball dips towards deep square leg
punches it down to deep extra cover for a couple
good ball, fizzed up and nearly shaved the outside edge, cramped him for room as well
bangs it short and he swivels and clubs it over midwicket, he leaps but the ball cleared him proper, down to deep midwicket
gets beside the line and cuts it down to sweeper cover
this time he brings it closer to the off stump, Hussey nearly slashes that to the keeper
fires that wide outside off, too short and the ball angles away from him
outside off and pushed to backward point
down the leg side and wide called
drives this one down to deep backward point
Harbhajan bowls it down the leg side and it beats the keeper but it appeared as if he was taking out his frustration on Karthik, poor ball to be honest, he should be blaming himself
gets on his knee and sweeps firmly to the deep
bat-pad but it lobbed away to safety, no close fielders
tries to sweep but fails to make proper contact
length delivery and he pulls it down to deep midwicket
they've got the danger man, Marsh stays at the crease and tries to loft it over the off side, the ball didn't come onto the bat and hence resulted in a top edge that swirled to Harbhajan at cover
slower ball down the leg side and Marsh fails to punish that away
back of a length on the stumps and he pushes it to point
makes room and chips down the track and ends up steering it to deep point
too wide outside off and he chops it down to sweeper cover
runs a length delivery down to third man
aims for the yorker on the pads but the wrong ball to bowl with the fine leg up, gentle tickle sent it to fine leg
Hussey exposed his stumps and the ball nipped back in and hits his back pad, only the bowler appealed but that wasn't hitting
works it down to deep midwicket
one-handed slog from the left-hander and it was heading to the rope at wide long-on but Franklin was brilliant, slid and parried it to deep midwicket
optimistic appeal by Pollard, pitched outside leg and hit the pads wide of the stumps as he tried to work it away
short outside off and he cuts to backward point
he flicks it down to backward square leg
heads up! Tossed up on the off stump and Hussey was on his knee early and slogs him high over deep midwicket
takes a few paces down the pitch and checks his shot to long-on
full on  middle and leg and worked to deep midwicket
tossed up down the leg side and swept to fine leg
beats him this time, close to cut and the ball fizzes past the edge
tucks him up for room and he chops it to the off side
slower one down the leg side and he whips it down to deep square leg
full outside off and he drives down to sweeper cover
gets beside the line and steers it to third man
false shot by Marsh, the ball angles away and beats the bat as he tries to knock it to the off side
goes back and whips it down to long-on
on middle and leg and flicks it down to deep midwicket
fires it wide down the leg side
chips down the track and he works it down to deep midwicket
gets forward and clips it down to long-on
gets well forward and he drives him down to sweeper cover
tossed up and he works it down to long-on
punches it solidly back to the bowler
steered towards Pollard at point, they decide against the single
Munaf just about hangs on! Saina tries to hook a short delivery and he takes his eyes off the ball and gets a top edge that swirls to fine leg, Munaf was under it and the ball very nearly popped out
came on a bit slow and he easily steered it past slip and down to third man, Marsh slips as he turns for a second run, Saini slipped too earlier trying to sweep
slower and shorter and he pulls and keeps it down, Rayudu's there at the deep to pick up
good length outside off and steered down to short third man
excellent over, tucks Marsh up for room, the ball clips his thigh and lobs towards slip
pushed towards midwicket, shaping to be a good over
good length on the off stump and pushed back to the bowler
gets behind the line and clips it to the on side
good length outside the off stump and he gets good carry to the keeper again, funny old pitch this
that's a nice length and line, pitched up and in the channel just wide of off stump, well left
keeps a touch low before reaching the keeper
dishes out a short one down the leg side, neat pull down to fine leg where the Punjab dug-out is, poor length on this slow pitch and the line was bad because the fine leg was up
full and he steers it just wide of the fielder at point
nice way to ease off the mark, half volley on the pads and he uses his wrists well and whips it wide of square leg
that's an off dismissal, RP saw the batsman give the charge and bowls it wide outside off, Mandeep had to really stretch out to whack that and only managed a thick edge to the keeper
couldn't make use of the Freehit, short ball which he tries to pull and he misses it completely
he oversteps! Full delivery on the stumps and he squeezes it back to the bowler
clips it towards midwicket
he makes the mistake of giving himself width and he smashes that down to deep point
outside edge and he runs it down to third man, how about a slip?
he makes room straightaway and lofts him over extra cover, didn't get as much behind the shot as he would have liked but enough to clear the infield
another short-arm pull and he finds Peterson at deep square leg, not quite short enough
was that a chance? You could say that, Harbhajan tries to hang on to one hammered to him at short midwicket, looked like the ball just dropped short of him
bowls it straight and he can only punch it back to the bowler
pulls and length delivery and he picks the length early, Peterson's there in the deep, nice looking shot though
makes a bit of room and chops it down to the off side
poor delivery again, short and too straight, he has the time to pull it behind square and the fine leg is up
keeps it straight and he clips it to the on side
on the stumps and he whips it away wide of square leg for a couple
makes himself room and he gets a thick outside edge that flies past the keeper, a slip would have been handy there
punches it towards cover and he Mandeep sets off and wisely heads back to his crease, fielder under-arms the throw to the stumps
that's a gift from McKay, too short and the pitch isn't the quickest either, picks the length and clubs it over midwicket
good length on the stumps and chopped to the off side
a bit too straight and he whips it away towards deep midwicket
chases the movement again as he chops it down towards third man
the away movement teases him as he flashes and misses
this one jagged back in sharply and he had to hop at the crease to fend it off
that's a gift, the fine leg is up and he what does he do? Bowl it down the leg side, easily whipped away over the fielder
pushed back to the bowler, quiet first over for Punjab
down the track and steered towards point where Tendulkar slides and cuts it off, always a louder cheer when he's in play
too full on the pads and worked wide of mid-on, fielder at the deep mops up
full on middle and leg and whipped away towards midwicket
Saini slips as he sweeps, totally lost his balance there
driven firmly but straight to cover, full delivery
Mumbai pull off a stunning win here! Rayudu makes room and Mahmood fires it full on the stumps and he crashes that past the short cover fielder who was unmoved, deep cover had no chance
comes round the wicket and he chips it in the air down to deep midwicket, drops short of the fielder, only one!
fires it full down the leg side on seeing him make room and he hammers it in the air down to long-off, 3 needed off 3
bangs it in short and he pulls and the ball hits his helmet and rolls to the off side
hammered back to the bowler and it nearly carried to him on the full
27 off the over! What a nightmare for Chawla! Rayudu is still merciless as he chips down the track and launches him rows over long-on, it's down to 5 off 6 balls
21 runs and counting! Chawla tosses it up outside off and Rayudu takes a few paces forward and lofts crisply rows over long-off
another reverse sweep! But didn't time it well, hammered it down to cover, scampered to the crease and beat the throw
wham! What are we in for here? The conventional slog this time, tossed up on middle and leg and Peterson gets on his knee and slams that over deep midwicket
this is getting closer! Chawla makes the mistake of dropping short and this was close to the switch hit, turns the other way and clubs it down to deep extra cover
the reverse sweep! He was in position early, friendly length ball and he swung that down to third man
big swing and a miss, a short one and Rayudu tries to slog that away
makes room and slaps it down to third man

Harbhajan's bad day has gotten worse, strange old shot, he stayed at the crease and played a sort of tennis forehand and the top edge went swirling down to long-off, the fielder was well in front of the rope
bowls him a short one straightaway, he  swings and misses

is this the turning point? Sharma throws his head back in frustration and yells out, he made room to slap that over the off side but ended up slashing it straight to backward point, it dipped to Mahmood
full toss thank you very much, fetches that from the off stump and he clubbed that across the line over deep square leg and that's his fifty
down the track and a big swing and he gets an inside edge that beats the keeper
bowls it flat and Rohit stays back and mistimes the pull
Free Hit: Pounds a flat delivery down the track and Bhatt boots it away
looks like it was a back-foot no-ball! Comes forward and drives to cover
uses his feet and clips him over midwicket
heads up! Rayudu makes room and uses his feet and smacks that flat over the bowler's head, rocketed to the sight screen
comes over the wicket and Rohit makes a lot of room and drives to sweeper cover
backs away and he flicks it down to fine leg, Awana picks up
bowls it short and he pulls him flat down to deep square leg in  front of Mandeep
Rayudu walks down the track and lofts him down to deep midwicket
too full again and easily works it away down to Mandeep at deep square leg
the full-toss bug bites Praveen, on the hips and Rohit easily clips it over the leg side and down to long leg
strays wide down the leg side, can't control the swing there
he gives him a low full toss which he can only play to long-on
Rohit at his stylish best! Bowls from over the wicket, he chips down the track, uses his feet and clips it elegantly over midwicket, bisected the gap in the deep well
comes down the track and clips a low full toss wide of long-on
uses his feet and drills it down to long-off
comes over the wicket to the right-hander, the ball rolls to the off side
works it down to square leg for a single
with Rohit there's always a big one to break the lull, length delivery on the pads and he stays at the crease and lofts it effortlessly over wide long-on
drops it with soft hands to the off side and sets off

if Pollard was batting at Hamilton that would have gone for six, he made room and whip that away over the on side and he connected well but it was too flat, the ball went flying to Mandeep at the edge of deep midwicket
overthrows! Clipped to midwicket and the backing up wasn't there, Rohit calls for the second
terrible delivery, full toss down the leg side and the fine leg was up too, just a faint touch was enough to fetch a boundary
fizzes off the pitch and beats the outside edge as he tries to steer it away
punches it down to sweeper cover
stays back and whips it away down to deep midwicket and he hurries him for the second run
flat six! Tossed up outside off and it's a Rohit special, sent that over wide long-off
down the leg side and wide called, beats the keeper
gets down the track and pushes it down to sweeper cover
good bouncer to end the over, Pollard had to sway back to evade that, Mumbai need something special now
bangs it in short and he pulls it down to deep midwicket
Pollard tries to go aerial over the off side and he miscues it to sweeper cover
a bit too straight and he easily works it away down to fine leg
nips this one back in sharply from outside off and catches Pollard's pad, he was surprised by that
gets forward and drives him down to sweeper cover
gets on the front foot and blocks it out

you can't keep that man Mahmood out of the game! Very soft dismissal, Karthik moved across his stumps to improvise and scoop that over short fine leg, it was a full toss which tamely lobbed to Mahmood at short fine leg
drops it a bit short and he stays back and works it to deep midwicket
drops it to the off side for a quick single
not much turn and he gets forward and pushes it to the off side
half volley on the middle and leg line and forcefully drive to long-on
gets beside the line and punches it to sweeper cover
drifts on the pads and he works it away down to long-on
gets beside the line and steers it towards point
gets a short one and he pulls it down to deep square leg
the short interval brings a wicket! What a break for Mahmood, Tendulkar made room to smash that straight or over the on side, he managed a thin inside edge which travelled flat to the keeper
tries to paddle it away and the ball hits his pads and rolls away to the on side
makes room and punches it towards long-on
the turn squares him up, outside edge rolls to point
steers it down to point and Tendulkar tells him to stay
makes room and chips it in the air to long-on
Tendulkar risks going a long way across to sweep, exposed his leg stump and just managed to get some bat to sweep it very fine
stays behind the line and pushes it back to the bowler
Mahmood will love to see the replay of that! Lovely delivery, the ball landed on middle and moved away late, it completely squared up Franklin who got an outside edge to the keeper
this one fizzes off the good length and nearly shaves the edge on the way to the keeper
gets behind the line and drives down to mid-on
gets beside the line and steers it down to third man, the fifty is up
inauspicious start, short delivery and not the wisest on this pitch, Tendulkar shuffled across and pulled it stylishly past short fine leg
clips it down to short fine leg
this time the extra bounce takes Tendulkar by surprise as he tries to cut, beats the edge
straighter one and he works it down to deep midwicket
not tossing it up much, stays back and works it down to mid-on
drifts on the pads and he easily clips it to short fine leg
whips a length ball down to deep midwicket, steady start by Mumbai
this was the shot he was attempting the previous ball, pitched up and wide outside off and he crashed that past the arc between cover and  mid-off
Awana tempts him with width and Franklin swings and misses
clipped off the pads down to short fine leg, Praveen was happy to give him the single
just over Hussey's reach! He lofted it over mid-on and didn't quite time that properly, Hussey ran back but managed to pull it back
full delivery and smashed straight to mid-off
bangs it in short and he's penalised for the bouncer
low full toss outside the off stump and jammed out towards mid-off, good over from Praveen
slower ball swinging in on the pads and easily whipped away to mid-on
a bit too straight and he eases it down to deep midwicket
even better yorker this time, he made a bit of room and failed to squeeze it out
the yorker keeps him quiet, he set himself up to drive down the ground but could only squeeze it to mid-off
knocked towards midwicket for a quick single
Tendulkar creates a boundary opportunity, the length is a bit predictable so he makes room and slaps it through the gap between point and cover
makes a bit of room and slaps it to cover point
bashes a full delivery to mid-off who's at the edge of the circle, they take a single
stays behind the line and works it just wide of mid-on
risky single! Dropped towards cover and Franklin set off, the fielder has a shy at the stumps but misses
full on the off stump and punched firmly towards mid-off
crashing straight drive but straight to mid-off, looked like a boundary when it left the bat
gives him width and he punches it straight to cover
fullish on the pads and worked away down to long-on
full outside the off stump and squeezed out to point
comes round the wicket and Franklin flashes at it and gets an outside edge that flies away to third man
effortless! Length delivery shaping to the off stump and he easily clipped it wide of midwicket, the timing was special
full and clipped down to deep midwicket for a single
flatter delivery and he forces it back to the bowler
chips down the track and works it down to deep midwicket
lovely shot, tossed up on the off and middle line and he got on his knee and swept that high over the leg side, down to the vacant long leg region
easily clipped away down to midwicket
paddles it away but it was straight to fine leg
Franklin quietly pushes it back to the bowler and Praveen for no reason flings the ball back to the batsman, Franklin was unmoved and Praveen apologised immediately
fullish on the off stump and he clips it wide of midwicket
wide outside the off stump and he chops it to the off side
inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls to the off side
swings away and he neatly steers that with little effort past point and Bhatt does really well to slide and cut it off
edgy start to the chase, ball keeps low and Franklin gets a tame outside edge that races to third man
